inlines.text: 이 페이지는 작위·권리·명분·인준 도메인의 기계 입력, 검증 순서, 계약 계산, 상태·보존 경계, 오류·보류 경로를 구조 다이어그램으로 보여준다. 원천은 해당 메커니즘 계약과 2026-10-08 전환 지도며, 수치 승인 상태는 원문 계약을 따른다.

소비자 계약(authority-with-optional-forgery-performance-contest): Same right/title/basis persists through suspension; authority/consent/ratification separate. Forgery performance win creates no recognized right or war authority.

blocks.text:
legal-holder [] holders(titleId) = beneficiaries of active rights recognized as holding rights for exact titleId
pressability [] pressable = right.status == active AND exact title exists AND beneficiary alive AND actor has separate war authority AND registered CB binds actor, beneficiary, title, target and effects
transfer [] same rightId/titleId/basisId, new beneficiary only after exact consent, authority, required ratification and one atomic commit
inheritance-recognition [] recognized successor only when a recorded current title-specific eligibility record names the successor; transferability alone is insufficient
eligibility-loss [] active -> suspended for the same rightId/titleId/basisId; no deletion, reassignment or fabricated expiry
fabrication-mandate [] one exact authorized worker + one exact mandateEventId + one exact target title/beneficiary; mandate is consumed once and creates no right without separate completion/recognition event
cb-beneficiary-survival [] beneficiary death invalidates the frozen beneficiary CB unless a separately authored CB replacement rule exists; attacker never silently becomes beneficiary
duplicate-basis [] different rightId values with the same beneficiaryId/titleId may coexist when basisId differs; no merge, overwrite or exclusive inference
same-title-restoration [] a suspended title-invalid right may restore only to active with the same rightId and exact same titleId after explicit restored-title version evidence
D10-F1 [후보·승인 전] pressable=right.active && exactTitleExists && beneficiaryAlive && separateWarAuthority && registeredCBBindsAllRequiredIds
D10-F2 [후보·승인 전] eligibilityLoss: same rightId/titleId/basisId -> suspended; restoration requires exact same titleId and evidence; transfer changes beneficiary only after consent/authority/ratification

inlines.text: D10의 나머지 계약 잎은 운용 흐름에 연결된 대조 원장으로 보존한다. 역사 참조식과 미결 값은 운용 간선에 넣지 않는다.

items.text: title — TitleRecord (stable title identity and registered territory set)
control — ControlRecord | null (effective control of a registered title/territory scope)
event — typed D10 event (immutable event identity at exact revision/rules version)
ratification — RatificationEvidence[] (registered institution, scope and evidence identifiers)

inlines.text: 자료 소유자는 D10 작위·권리·명분 기록; D09 직위, D11 양도 계약, D13 재산, D16 전쟁 권한, 유지 계약은 legal-holder·pressability·transfer·inheritance-recognition·eligibility-loss·fabrication-mandate·cb-beneficiary-survival·duplicate-basis·same-title-restoration다. 상태 소유 경계는 rightId,titleId,basisId,beneficiary,active/suspended,recognition evidence,CB exact binding,mandate/completion receipts. 커밋 규칙: Version-bound owner candidate; current grant/consent/receipt guards; preserve quantities/identities/consumed progress; atomic accepted receipt. Exact source contract referenced below.

items.text: 후보 오류: E_POLICY, E_AUTHORITY, E_CONSENT, E_REVISION
기존 평가기 오류: E_TYPE, E_FIELDS, E_DUPLICATE_ID, E_TITLE, E_VERSION, E_REPLAY_CONFLICT, E_STALE_SNAPSHOT, E_CONSENT, E_AUTHORITY, E_RATIFICATION

어댑터 결합 규칙: tagged unresolved -> Held E_UNRESOLVED; malformed missing required key -> Rejected E_INPUT; stale -> E_REVISION; unit -> E_UNIT; conservation -> E_CONSERVATION. Authority/consent/feasibility privately distinct.

inlines.text: 제거 대상 차용 산식: —. No confirmed GURPS arithmetic in inspected formulaSheet/evaluator; retain ordinary counts, sets, sums and policy locks. D09 reference explicitly invokes no contest.

items.text: pure safe integer margin/outcome and caller-authorized projection, no profile/rating/receipt authority
caller-supplied trusted boolean gates only; no provenance/authentication/world resolver, absent tag unsupported

inlines.text: 현재 범위 한계: Named helper only; no complete authoritative domain state owner/transaction/consumer workbook. 다음 구현 단위는 U-D10-right-state-and-mandate(TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/right-state-and-mandate.mjs, TOOL/tools/mechanisms/original-trpg/right-state-and-mandate.test.mjs). 인물·세계 수치 승인과 별개로, 이 아치파이는 계약 구조만을 보여준다.
